anya: Quick q: /v1/generate precedence when both model_id and region_hint present — which param wins? Docs not clear. tagging @sam @mike for API contract details.

sam: Short answer: model_id pins a served model. region_hint only used if model_id is absent or is a 'family:*' wildcard. We updated the contract in the PR but didn't publish. Example:

```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model_id": "rw-text-1.3",
  "region_hint": "eu-west-1",
  "prompt": "..."
}
```

sam: If rw-text-1.3 isn't available in eu-west-1 and policy=local_only, request errors; if policy=allow_cross_region, runtime will try cross-region same variant then fallback variants.

mike: Add: fallback order: 1) exact variant same region 2) same family same region (quantized/float variant) 3) cross-region same variant 4) cross-region family variant 5) error. Also we include served_model metadata in response when fallback occurs.

lina: Where in the response? I thought served_model was only in admin logs.

sam: We attach served_model in the response envelope under 'served_model' with fields id, region, reason. Example:

```json
{
  "id": "resp_abc",
  "output": "...",
  "served_model": {"id":"rw-text-1.3-q4","region":"us-west-2","reason":"fallback-variant-not-in-region"}
}
```

ben: Heads up, I added param validation to the api-service to reject model_id+region_hint combos when policy=local_only. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-service/pull/4227. Could reviewers? @anya @mike

anya: I'll review later today. Also want canary plan for the change so older clients don't break.

mike: Canary: start with low-traffic tenant group 'beta-10' for 1 hour then 10% traffic 24h. ops: can we enforce a soft-deprecation log rather than hard reject for 2 weeks? @ops

deploy-bot: Canary started: routing-param-validation on api-service -> canary-2026-03-17. URL: https://deploys/redwood/canary/123 :eyes:

qa-bot: Test matrix: failing case: model_id=rw-translate-2.0 + region_hint=eu-north-1 with policy=allow_cross_region passes, but served_model.reason shows 'cross-region-fallback' — test expects 'served-elsewhere' string. Updating assertion in tests.

sam: I'll update test expectations and add contract doc in repo: docs/api/routing-precedence.md

lina: Quick product Q: If a customer pins model via 'model_pin' in dedicated, does this override model_id param?

sam: Yes, dedicated/reserved capacity pins at serving layer have higher priority than per-request model_id — they are enforced after auth check. We should add that to the public docs.

ben: Review reminder: pinged codeowners on PR. small change in route resolver: one-line.

anya: Ack. will review and then +1 if canary looks stable. thx all :thumbsup:
